title: Built the AI stock research tool from my earlier post — live now, requesting beta access
author: siddharth81286
selftext:
A few weeks ago I asked here if people would pay for an AI-generated deep research tool for Indian stocks. Got great pushback — especially around AI hallucination and whether people even want detailed reports vs a simple verdict. Built it with that feedback in mind.

It's live: https://thesis-guard-one.vercel.app/

What it does:

• Type any NSE/BSE ticker → structured report in \\\~90 seconds

• Mcap, Pledge, Financials, PE, moat assessment,

7-category risk register

• Numbers come from live data sources — AI interprets and narrates, never generates figures

• SEBI-safe verdict: Research-worthy / Watchlist / Avoid, never buy/sell/hold

To get beta access: go to the link above, enter your Gmail on the

homepage to request access. I'm approving requests manually on my end,

so you'll get an email once you're in — check your spam folder if you don't see it in your inbox within a bit.

The UI is still a work in progress, so you may notice a few rough edges. Also, some links—especially those in the footer—are not functional yet, as this is still a beta version.

Please let me know your honest feedback. It will really help improve the platform.

Once you've requested access, drop a "Done" in the comments so I know to look out for your email and approve it faster.

What I'd love feedback on:

1. Pick a stock you know well, generate a report — tell me what's wrong, not what's right

2. Does the verdict feel useful?

3. Any number or claim that seems off?

4. Would you come back next week, or was this a one-time click?

5. Is the data accurate and presented properly?

6. What improvements would you suggest?

7. Do you think this would be useful for other users? If so, in what way?

Not selling anything yet — no payment flow exists. Just trying to learn if this is genuinely useful.

Thanks to everyone whose feedback shaped this.
